first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A close-view person with short brown hair, a dark blue-gray top, brown trousers, and a brown shoulder strap, who first rolls and then proceeds along the passageway.

entities.name: green foreground counter
entities.identification: A damaged teal wooden-frame counter in the image-left foreground, with a light-colored bag-shaped object on the countertop and open space visible underneath.

entities.name: shop stall with a red roller shutter
entities.identification: A red rectangular shop stall on the right, with a gray roller shutter bearing a large red pattern and a dark rectangular closed opening on the side.

entities.name: wet flagstone passageway
entities.identification: A gray-brown paved passageway between the stalls, with wet marks, reflections, and scattered papers.

entities.name: distant curved building
entities.identification: A light-colored multistory building in the right rear, with curved balconies featuring green edges and light-colored railings.

entities.name: group of people lying in front of the steps
entities.identification: A background group consisting of at least two people lying near the blue-and-white steps, excluding Person A.

entities.name: green open goods stall
entities.identification: A teal goods stall on the right, with a wide opening, diagonal braces, multiple shelves, and visibly peeling panels.

entities.name: orange-fruit table
entities.identification: A low orange slatted display table in front of the shop stall with a red roller shutter, with pineapples arranged on top.

entities.name: blue-and-white steps
entities.identification: Wide multilevel steps leading to the market hall, with light-gray treads and risers faced with light-blue and white square tiles.

entities.name: wooden-slat partition
entities.identification: A tall yellow-brown partition with horizontal slats at the rear edge of the stalls on the left side of the passageway, near the steps.

entities.name: raised market hall
entities.identification: A market hall behind the steps, with a brown-red pitched roof, wide eaves, light-colored square columns, a dark counter, and strings of lights.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: A short gray handgun held in Person A's right hand, with the body of the gun discernible during the latter part of the roll and while running.

entities.name: sky between the buildings
entities.identification: Light-blue sky and patches of white cloud visible between the rooftops.

entities.name: surrounding market buildings
entities.identification: A group of blue-gray and yellow-brown buildings on both sides of the passageway, excluding the separately listed shop stalls, market hall, and curved building.

entities.name: hanging green plants along the building edge
entities.identification: Clusters of dark- and light-green leaves extending downward from building edges and balcony edges.

entities.name: light-colored bag-shaped object
entities.identification: Beige-gray bulging soft bag-shaped goods on the counter and stall racks on the left.

entities.name: market container
entities.identification: A collection of yellow-green and brown bottles and jars, and blue-green bucket-shaped containers.

entities.name: pineapple
entities.identification: Fruit on the orange-fruit table with a grayish yellow-green oval body and a gray-green crown of pointed leaves.

entities.name: stacked box-shaped goods
entities.identification: Beige-gray-brown and blue-green flat rectangular stacked objects on a supporting surface at the right end of the small light-green table, above a brown cabinet.

entities.name: small light-green table
entities.identification: A narrow, elongated light-green table on the right, with a rectangular tabletop, slender legs, and a low crossbar, adjoining a brown cabinet at its right end.

entities.name: overhead cables
entities.identification: Thin black lines hanging in a crisscross pattern between the buildings and elevated poles.

entities.name: scattered papers on the ground
entities.identification: Scattered light-gray and off-white thin pieces on the flagstone ground.

entities.name: shallow puddle in the passageway
entities.identification: An irregular shallow water surface in a low part of the passageway, with blue-gray and brown reflections.

entities.name: gray smoke near the market hall
entities.identification: Gray-brown translucent clouds of smoke near and above the market hall's eaves.
